findings.finding: [geometry] The approved 220 artboard (golden) draws the details pane's empty state ('Select a package to see its details.') in a pane about 49 px wide right of a sash at x=170, and the spec composition also calls for that empty state. The capture has no details pane: the list column, tab strip and bulk toolbar span the full 220 px. All header, tab, toolbar, section-header and row positions above and inside the list match the artboard pixel for pixel. DS-OVERFLOW-5 and the overflow table (list pane min 170, details pane min 220) do not allow both panes at this width, so the capture follows the rule and the artboard and spec disagree with it. Reported once as an artboard/spec conflict. | [states] The details pane and its empty state are missing at 220: the approved artboard draws a details pane right of the list (x 170 to 220, about 50 px wide) holding the empty-state sentence 'Select a package to see its details.', and the spec's composition says this rest state shows the details pane's empty state (package-details-panel is not marked composed). The capture draws only the list across the full width, so nothing tells the user how to see a package's details. Measured fact for the disposition: the artboard's pane is about 50 px wide, below the 220 px details-pane minimum of the overflow table (DS-OVERFLOW-5), and no spec entry or rule declares that the pane drops at this width.
